final_review_findings.trigger: Import an otherwise valid .slconnect text file prefixed by a UTF8 BOM (EF BB BF), as some Windows text writers produce.
final_review_findings.actual: Java trim retains U+FEFF, so Pairing.parse rejects the prefix instead of pairing.
final_review_findings.impact: Owner must export UTF8 without BOM, or paste the SL1 code directly. No secret disclosure or upload occurs.
final_review_findings.repair: Not fixed after final review, following owner instruction.

limits: No phone/emulator install, application control, hardware Keystore test, real relay pairing or end-to-end laptop job was run.
SAF attachment/save/share, screen geometry, device lifecycle and native media codecs/playback require owner-authorized device checks.
App must remain foreground for encrypted pull and file transfers. Laptop jobs continue independently.
An ambiguous mutation is not automatically replayed; uncertain sends require explicit chat readback before clearing their draft.
Uploads and downloads are capped at256MiB per file. Document providers must report upload size. Transfers interrupted by backgrounding are not automatically resumed.
Media is private app cache, not unlimited durable offline storage. Owner can clear it; Android may evict it. Saved/shared external copies remain separate.
English-only personal UI and pinned compatible dependencies account for retained lint warnings; immediate journal commit is intentional before send.
Pairing file must be kept private outside the app; forgetting locally does not revoke the relay token on the laptop.
Only pasted or file-imported pairing, not QR scanning, is implemented.
